controls: Negative control: uniform random factor base at matched cardinality and symmetry mode.
Construction control: uniformly ordered random x candidates using the same square-root and subgroup-test path as coordinate predicates.
Positive control: scalar progression expected to compress split supports and lose final expansion.
Baseline: measured Pollard rho on every generated curve using the same affine arithmetic.
Hash-chain control: the generator and imported coordinate-arithmetic dependency hashes must be emitted, recomputed, and enforced by the independent verifier.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Narrow H-ECDLP-RECURSIVE-001 if no coordinate family meets the joint expansion, compiler-cost, offline-cost, replication, and verifier thresholds.

inputs.field_modulus_policy: Seeded bit-size primes constrained to p mod 4 = 3 for deterministic square roots; this restricted field family is reported and is not a claimed weakness.

invalidation_rules: A generated curve is singular, supersingular, non-prime-order, or selected for a special j-invariant or p-1 property.
Subgroup order q is not strictly increasing with the bit-size schedule for a seed.
Factor-base cardinality differs from the smallest even B satisfying the frozen unordered-occupancy threshold.
A support entry, target, split witness, or rho logarithm fails direct arithmetic verification.
Any exact integer protocol field is represented as a Boolean or floating-point value.
Canonical generator or verifier run records a dirty Git tree.
Independent verifier does not reproduce all integer counts and promotion decisions.
Generator or imported coordinate-arithmetic dependency hash differs from the frozen verifier boundary.

primary: target success probability and ratio to random
functional split-advice entries, deep bytes, and ratios to random
functional-advice-byte S*T^2/(epsilon*q) ratio to matched random
online group operations and lookups per target and successful target
secondary: memory traffic estimate and peak RSS

experiment.objective: Measure the recursive expansion-compression frontier of coordinate factor bases under symmetry-corrected occupancy and fixed-curve split compilation.
stopping_rules: Stop a run at 900 seconds or 2 GiB peak RSS.
Stop a curve search after 128 coefficient attempts and retain an invalid run.
Do not promote the scalar-progression control or a signal seen at only one size.
Do not report a fitted exponent unless q is monotone and at least three distinct B values are present; even then label it exploratory toy evidence.
experiment.success_criterion: Promote a coordinate family/symmetry/m configuration only if exact final target support is at least 0.8x matched random-scalar, its functional-advice-byte times average-online-group-operations-squared divided by exact success probability times subgroup order is at most 0.8x matched random-scalar, offline group operations are at most 4.0x matched random-x, and the signal appears in at least three instances spanning two q sizes with exact independent verification. This implementation-specific normalized S*T^2/(epsilon*q) diagnostic is a follow-up gate, not a generic lower-bound calibration or breakthrough criterion.
experiment.title: Symmetry-corrected recursive expansion and split-compiler preflight
